body:
## Pull request overview

This PR fixes CI failures caused by a pnpm version mismatch: workflows had `version: 10.28.1` hardcoded while `package.json#packageManager` specified `pnpm@10.31.0`. The fix removes the explicit `version` parameter from `pnpm/action-setup@v4` in all affected workflows, letting the action auto-read the version from `packageManager` in `package.json`.

**Changes:**
- Removed hardcoded `version: 10.28.1` from `pnpm/action-setup@v4` in `ci.yml` (3 jobs), `lint.yml`, `pr-automation.yml`, and `validate-deps.yml`
- This establishes `package.json#packageManager` as the single source of truth for the pnpm version across all CI workflows

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated no comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `.github/workflows/ci.yml` | Removed explicit pnpm version from 3 job steps (test, build-core, build-docs) |
| `.github/workflows/lint.yml` | Removed explicit pnpm version from typecheck job |
| `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml` | Removed explicit pnpm version from changeset-check job |
| `.github/workflows/validate-deps.yml` | Removed explicit pnpm version from validate job |
